title: Gingerbread Houses Watercolor Clipart
author: Nicolle's Colorful Art
description:
Gingerbread Houses Watercolor Clipart is a whimsical Christmas collection filled with charming gingerbread cottages, candy-inspired houses, snowy winter homes and festive holiday details.
This cozy watercolor set includes 83 individual Christmas illustrations featuring gingerbread houses decorated with candy canes, peppermint sweets, holly, bows, frosting, Christmas greenery, snow and warm glowing windows. The artwork combines classic red, green, white and gingerbread tones with playful storybook-style details for a magical Christmas look.
The cute hand-painted watercolor aesthetic makes these designs perfect for both traditional and whimsical holiday projects. Use them to create cozy Christmas compositions, gingerbread villages, festive stationery, printable decorations and seasonal craft designs.
This is a Digital Instant Download.

Each illustration has a charming handcrafted appearance that works beautifully for cozy Christmas, gingerbread and winter-themed designs.
